en.chat_requests_hint: People you follow can always send you messages.
en.chat_enable_calls_hint: Choose who can call you after enabling calling.
en.chat_relay_hint: Hide your IP address during calls. This may reduce call quality.
en.chat_calls_hint: You must send someone a message before they can call you.
en.chat_nickname_hint: Nicknames are encrypted and visible only to you on this device.
en.chat_pin_hint: Choose a memorable passcode and keep it private.
en.chat_reset_confirm: Reset this device’s Chat cache and lock messages?
en.chat_no_media: No media, links or documents in this conversation
en.chat_call_web_hint: The Chat SDK does not expose calling. This opens X’s chat interface.
en.chat_safety_hint: Compare identity key fingerprints with the other person.
en.chat_voice_play_failed: Could not play this voice message. Try again.
en.chat_message_delete_confirm: Delete this message from your conversation only.
en.chat_message_load_original: Original message is not loaded. Load earlier messages.
en.chat_background_note: Sets the background for this conversation on this account. Tap Apply to save.
en.chat_background_photo_failed: Could not read this photo. Please choose another.
en.chat_background_apply_failed: Could not apply the background. Please try again.
en.meow_intro: Install MeoW and link your nickname here. An always-on HTTPS relay can forward X message alerts while Harmony X is closed.
en.meow_privacy: The relay decrypts X push summaries. Previews forward these summaries to MeoW; otherwise only a new-message alert is sent. X login cookies and chat PINs are never uploaded. Use a relay you trust.
en.meow_registered: Registered; check real message delivery below
en.meow_partial: Setup incomplete; finish registration or stop
en.meow_sign_in: Sign in to this account through the X web login first.
en.meow_scope_note: This channel is configured per account for direct messages only. The switches above control local notifications. Configure MeoW sound, banners and Do Not Disturb in MeoW or system settings. A successful test does not verify X message delivery.
en.meow_code_sent: Code sent. Enter it within 5 minutes.
en.meow_test_sent: The relay submitted the test to MeoW. Check your device for delivery.
en.meow_waiting: No real delivery recorded. Send a message from another account, then check again.
en.meow_delivery_error: MeoW delivery failed or was rate limited. The relay will retry.
en.meow_url_error: Enter an HTTPS relay origin without a path, credentials or query parameters.
en.meow_token_error: The relay access token must contain at least 32 characters.
en.meow_nickname_error: Enter a valid MeoW nickname without slashes.
en.meow_code_error: The code is incorrect, expired, or the request is invalid. Check and retry.
en.meow_auth_error: Invalid relay access token. Check the server configuration.
en.meow_missing_error: Subscription or MeoW nickname not found. Check the configuration.
en.meow_rate_error: Too many requests. Try again later.
en.meow_response_error: Incomplete relay response. Alerts have not been enabled.
en.meow_cleanup_note: The relay is stopped and forwarding has ended. X unregistration failed; retry cleanup.
en.meow_x_error: X rejected the push configuration. Check your login and network.
en.meow_network_error: Operation incomplete. Check the relay address, network and service, then retry.
en.meow_storage_error: Could not read push configuration. Keep app data and check storage.
en.meow_sign_out_error: MeoW forwarding has not been stopped for this account. Unlink it in notification settings before signing out.
en.storage_settings_desc: Storage usage, download location and cache cleanup
en.storage_total_note: Includes the installed app and app data. Copies saved in Gallery or your download folder are excluded.
en.storage_clear_confirm: Clear approximately %1$s of cache. Accounts, messages, drafts, pending attachments, download tasks and saved copies will be kept.
en.storage_clear_note: Cached content can be loaded again. Videos currently playing are reclaimed after the player releases the file.
en.storage_clear_done: Freed %1$s; cache still in use will be reclaimed later
en.storage_clear_partial: Freed %1$s. Some files could not be cleared; refresh and try again.
en.storage_clear_failed: Cache cleanup failed. Refresh and try again.
en.storage_directory_failed: Could not authorize the folder. Try again, or use the system Save As option in download tasks on unsupported devices.
en.storage_path_note: New files go into the HarmonyX subfolder. Changing location does not move previously saved files.
en.storage_path_authorize: This is the default location. Authorize a folder with the system picker before saving. Existing files are not moved.
en.storage_folder_fallback: This device cannot keep folder authorization. Save to download folder opens the system Save As picker.
en.storage_save_to_folder: Save to download folder by default
en.storage_save_target_note: When enabled, photos and videos go to the download folder. Otherwise, they go to Gallery.
en.storage_protected_note: Downloads, temporary edits, accounts and drafts are kept. Cancel or delete incomplete downloads individually in download tasks.
en.storage_network_note: Actual HarmonyX traffic since the last device boot, including media and requests. Counters restart after reboot.
en.storage_network_unavailable: App traffic is unavailable. Refresh later.
en.storage_stats_failed: Some storage data could not be read. Available statistics are shown; refresh to retry.
en.storage_permission_reason: To keep saving photos, videos and files in the download folder you select.
en.chat_contact_closed: @%s has a closed inbox. You can still message them using their X Number.
en.chat_contact_number_hint: Enter @%s’s 8-digit X Number to contact them.
en.chat_contact_number_rejected: X Number was not accepted. Check it and try again.
en.chat_contact_permission_failed: Could not load messaging permissions. Try again.
en.chat_media_queue_full: Too many pending media messages. Try again later or remove failed messages.
en.settings_translation_x_note: Translate posts with your signed-in X account, without an API key. X detects the source language; availability depends on your account and the X service.
en.post_translate_x_login: Sign in to X before using X / Grok translation.
en.xsettings_remote_note: Settings are saved to your current X account.
en.xsettings_official_desc: Continue in the app to complete verification or manage other options on X.
en.xsettings_partial: Some settings could not be loaded. Retry or open X settings.
en.xsettings_failed: Could not read or confirm the change. Retry or open X settings.
en.xsettings_account_changed: The active account changed. Reload settings.
en.xsettings_confirm_change: This change applies to your current X account. Continue?
en.xsettings_clear_contacts_confirm: Remove all contacts uploaded to this X account. This cannot be undone. Contacts on your device are kept.
en.xsettings_clear_locations_confirm: Remove location information from previously posted posts. This cannot be undone.
en.xsettings_revoke_confirm: The selected device will need to sign in again. Your current session is kept.
en.xsettings_revoke_all_confirm: Log out of every X session except this one. Other devices will need to sign in again.
en.xsettings_revoke_app_confirm: This app will lose its authorized access to your X account.
en.xsettings_local_filter_note: These filters only affect Harmony X. Manage account-wide muted words and accounts in Privacy and safety.
en.xsettings_web_account_changed: The active account changed. Go back and reopen this page.
en.xsettings_protect_posts_desc: Only approved followers can see your posts when enabled.
en.xsettings_protect_videos_desc: Prevent other people from downloading your new videos on X.
en.xsettings_mark_sensitive: Mark media you post as potentially sensitive
en.xsettings_mark_sensitive_desc: This setting applies to media you post on X.
en.xsettings_post_location_desc: Control whether your posts can include location information.
en.xsettings_sensitive_media: Display media that may contain sensitive content
en.xsettings_sensitive_media_desc: Syncs with your current X account and controls media shown in Harmony X.
en.xsettings_reply_filter_desc: Let X filter potentially unwanted replies to your posts.
en.xsettings_recommendations_desc: Manage recommendation preferences for this account; availability depends on the account.
en.xsettings_personalized_ads_desc: Allow X to personalize ads based on your activity.
en.xsettings_cross_device: Personalize based on your inferred identity
en.xsettings_cross_device_desc: Allow X to use activity from other devices for personalization.
en.xsettings_web_activity_desc: Control how X uses off-platform browsing activity for personalization.
en.xsettings_partner_sharing: Allow additional information sharing with business partners
en.xsettings_partner_sharing_desc: Manage additional data sharing between X and its business partners.
en.xsettings_location_personalization_desc: Allow X to personalize content based on your location history.
en.xsettings_grok_training: Allow data to be used for training and fine-tuning
en.xsettings_grok_training_desc: Manage permission to use public data and your Grok interactions, inputs and results for training.
en.xsettings_grok_personalization_desc: Allow X to personalize your experience with Grok.
en.xsettings_grok_memory_desc: Allow Grok to use memory for more relevant responses.
en.xnative_read_failed: Unable to load. Retry or verify your password if required.
en.xnative_save_failed: The operation was not completed. Check your input or retry.
en.xnative_deactivate_confirm: Your profile and posts will be hidden. Sign in within 30 days to reactivate; after that permanent deletion begins. Deactivate this account?
en.xnative_external_required: This step requires X credential or identity verification. Return here and refresh after completing it.
en.xnative_sensitive_confirmation: This changes your account and may revoke access or delete data. Continue?
en.xnative_available: This feature is unavailable for this account
en.xnative_invalid_password: Use at least 8 characters, matching confirmation and a different password.
en.xnative_invalid_keyword: Enter up to 140 characters and select a mute surface.
en.xnative_invalid_country: Enter a two-letter country code, such as CN.
en.xnative_archive_notice: X generates your archive. Open its secure download here when ready.
en.video_cast_failed: Unable to cast. Please try again.
en.settings_sheet_material_desc: Use the selected material for all sheets. Off by default; turning it off restores each sheet’s original appearance.
en.settings_sheet_material_unavailable: Requires HarmonyOS 7 or later. Sheets keep their original appearance on this device.
en.settings_sheet_material_save_failed: Could not save sheet material settings. Please try again.
